# sccfm-cli inventory devices cdfmc-managed-ftd cli execute

```text
$ sccfm-cli inventory devices cdfmc-managed-ftd cli execute --help

Usage: sccfm-cli inventory devices cdfmc-managed-ftd cli execute 
           [OPTIONS]

  Execute a show command on cdFMC-managed FTD devices. Only show commands are
  supported (e.g. show version, show failover).

Options:
  -n, --device-name TEXT      Device name to search for (supports wildcards like
                              'branch-*').
  -q, --query TEXT            Filter FTD devices by a Lucene query.
  -l, --limit INTEGER RANGE   Maximum records to return  [default: 50;
                              1<=x<=200]
  -o, --offset INTEGER RANGE  Pagination offset  [default: 0; x>=0]
  -u, --device-uids TEXT      List of device UIDs to execute the command on.
  -c, --command TEXT          The show command to execute (e.g. 'show version').
  --check                     Run a preflight check without performing the
                              operation.
  --format [table|json]       Output format  [default: table]
  --config-path PATH          Path to the configuration file (defaults to
                              ~/.sccfm-cli/config.json).
  --help                      Show this message and exit.
```
